items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: You asked Didi about it. Didi was playing with him. I never knew that. Didi was playing with him.

ctx.x: You don't remember her name. You must have known her a little bit. Richard M. Jones came back to New Orleans for, just for a visit. You mean?

Who? Yeah, he only came here. No, he came here instead. Look, he came here and stayed here. And when I saw him, he had formed the band around here, right here. That was around in the early 30s. And he had Didi. You asked Didi about it. Didi was playing with him. I never knew that. Didi was playing with him. Yeah? Who else was in the band? I forgot. But I saw him, I went up, I didn't go to nothing but dances and I saw them up at the, saw him up at the Bulls. We call it the Bulls, it's the Elks now. Yeah. But that…
Well, fish will go bad in a hurry. Hmm? Say fish will go bad in a hurry, I guess. Do you see my cousin?
